late_enrolment.note: B enrols concurrently with P's checkpoint, whose cut lists B's slot with no pseudonym; B1 acknowledges and B's device anchors on top of the enrolment. The peer stores the late events with no effect (Late), so B's vote, whose prev is its late anchor, is placed and counts, and the checkpoint takes effect. B enrols the slot again after the checkpoint (B2), its binding sealed under the checkpoint's twin_secret: valid at the peer, and bound to B at a replica that kept everything and at one that forgot. The erasure in the checkpoint's past waits for B's slot until B2 acknowledges it
